data.rapid_rise_auto_stop: Stop heating on rapid temperature rise

data_description.temperature_unit: Changing this will update both Home Assistant and the kettle's display unit
data_description.temp_set_method: Direct uses a single firmware command (fast). Dial emulates the physical dial (slower but compatible with older firmwares).
data_description.rapid_rise_auto_stop: Turn the kettle off when the temperature climbs faster than the threshold, which suggests it is empty or nearly empty.
data_description.rapid_rise_threshold: Rise rate (averaged over 10 s) that counts as rapid. A full kettle rises about 0.5 °C/s and a low fill about 1.5 °C/s. Range 1–10.
